summary: Synchronize and integrate OpenGeoHub and OpenLandMap sources with router and homepage
details: Merged PR #36 (017262d), enriched OpenGeoHub integration reference with per-repo usage boundaries and protocol distinctions, updated intent_router and gis_code_discovery for spatial prediction and ML, synchronized READMEs, index.html, explorer.html, and CHANGELOG, and passed all 394 repository tests.
tests: python scripts/validate_catalog.py; python scripts/validate_api_catalog.py; python scripts/validate_data_repositories.py; python scripts/validate_skill_pack.py; python scripts/build_manifest.py --check; python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
